editionLabel: Fourth Edition, Fantasy Flight Games English rules
firstPlayerRule: Randomly determine one player to take the speaker token. The speaker goes first when the game begins.
clarifications: In the strategy phase, players choose strategy cards starting with the speaker and going clockwise.
In the action phase, turns follow initiative order: the numbers on the chosen strategy cards, starting with 1.
The speaker token can change hands during the game through the Politics strategy card.

internalEvidence: Both PDFs are hosted on Fantasy Flight Games’ own CDN. Downloaded and text-extracted the 24-page Learn to Play (SHA-256 ac91632f142898db6c784be2bb4287875b31b7a3b4d6836bcef95f5e070d647d) and the Living Rules Reference v1.1 (SHA-256 c96015b37833df50636e787b597b7f76c97112c2a2c8886d7f0f9bce23af084f). Learn to Play page 6, First-Game Setup step 1: randomly determine one player to take the speaker token; the speaker goes first. Page 8: strategy cards are chosen beginning with the speaker clockwise, and the action phase uses initiative order. Rules Reference Complete Setup step 1 and rule 69.5 repeat the random speaker; rules 57 and 69.6 cover passing the token via Politics. Game identity: Twilight Imperium Fourth Edition components and factions (BGG 233078). Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The speaker picks strategy cards first, but action-phase turn order follows initiative numbers on strategy cards, so the speaker does not necessarily take the first action.
The Prophecy of Kings expansion and later rules reference versions were not reviewed.
